knownIssues: No live provider check ran because every required Runloop, GitHub, and Reflex environment name was unset. Provisioning, private mount authentication, billable cleanup, Reflex WebSocket connectivity, and UI state remain unverified live.
Person A could not edit the frozen root export or composition paths. Person C must export and instantiate the adapter factories before the package build exposes them through the public entry point.
Runloop cost is omitted because the consumed API responses do not expose attributable run cost. Cleanup failures are recorded in raw evidence and require operator follow-up.
Runloop standard shapes X_SMALL through XX_LARGE are supported. CUSTOM_SIZE cannot be constructed from the frozen request because it has no CPU, memory, or disk fields.
Reflex stop deduplication is process-local; a process restart may issue the documented idempotent stop sequence again.
headCommit records the final implementation and documentation commit immediately before this self-referential handoff-manifest commit; the final branch tip is reported separately at handoff.
integrationInstructions: Import createRunloopVerificationAdapter from src/adapters/runloop/index.ts and createReflexAgentSessionAdapter from src/adapters/reflex/index.ts, then add root exports in Person C-owned composition/public entry paths.

Supply durable persistArtifact and persistRawEvidence callbacks to the Runloop factory. Do not discard the pre-cleanup evidence write; Person B consumes only RawVerificationEvidenceV1 and owns all classification.
Resolve secret values in the composition root from the configured environment-variable names. Pass GitHub mount credentials only to the Runloop factory and never into command env or evidence.
Let Person B build prompts and parse bounded Reflex finalText. New sessions use the configured Persona; repair attempts pass the returned continuationId back unchanged.
Keep the critical controller outside Reflex: Person C invokes Reflex for authoring, Person B validates the patch, Runloop executes proof, and Person B/GitHub handle judgment and publication.
Run the budget-bounded live procedure in docs/runloop-reflex.md before release and confirm every Runloop Devbox id reaches shutdown.
